title: Introducing dots
summary: Dots by OpenAI are a proactive assistant that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.
body: Dots by OpenAI are a proactive assistant that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了全新产品“dots”，这是一款主动式助手，能够在复杂的项目和日常任务中持续自主运行，帮助用户在推进工作的同时保持对任务进程的控制。原始信息显示：Dots by OpenAI are a proactive assistant that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing dots”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出了名为dots的新主动式助手产品，拓展了跨项目持续工作的AI代理应用场景。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
